listing.name: God of War: Ghost of Sparta — PSP Web Recomp (snuri00)
listing.original_game_title: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
listing.summary: The project reports reaching combat in two Ready at Dawn titles while skipping movies. Browser saves are not directly compatible with encrypted PSP saves. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PSP ISO or extracted disc; decrypted EBOOT via external PSP_DECRYPT; exact regional IDs not stated in README.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Linux, follow setup.sh, port.sh and serve.sh to compile generated C++ into WASM from your own input and separately decrypted EBOOT. The browser player reads original disc data over HTTP Range. The native flag creates a headless diagnostic tool rather than the normal player.

warnings: The project reports reaching combat in two Ready at Dawn titles while skipping movies. Browser saves are not directly compatible with encrypted PSP saves.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
